result.summary: Found 1 significant visual issue: restaurant metadata is overlapping beneath the first “Popular right now” listing.

issues.description: Under “Tokumaru Ramen Bar,” the delivery-time and delivery-fee labels overlap, creating a garbled line around “25–30 min” and the delivery price.
issues.suggestion: Place each metadata item in a properly spaced flex row, prevent negative margins or absolute-position collisions, and allow the row to wrap cleanly on narrow screens.
